The test cannot be completed — coordinate-precise drawing and drag gestures on the canvas are required but cannot be performed by the test agent.

Because the main test interactions (drawing at specific quadrants, precise marquee selection, drag-to-float, and single-pixel nudge verification) depend on coordinate-level pointer events that are not available in this test environment, the test is blocked. If a way to perform coordinate-based clicks/drags is provided (or an alternate UI method to create precise strokes programmatically), the test can be re-run.
